items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Corsair colour, radius and base styles for light and dark mode. Every component relies on these variables; override --primary, --primary-foreground and --ring to apply your brand.

items.name: theme-blue
items.title: Theme: Blue
items.description: The Corsair theme on a slate base with a blue primary. Installs the theme first, then sets its colours and radius; every text pair meets WCAG AA.

items.name: theme-violet
items.title: Theme: Violet
items.description: The Corsair theme on a zinc base with a violet primary. Installs the theme first, then sets its colours and radius; every text pair meets WCAG AA.

items.name: theme-rose
items.title: Theme: Rose
items.description: The Corsair theme on a stone base with a rose primary. Installs the theme first, then sets its colours and radius; every text pair meets WCAG AA.

items.name: theme-emerald
items.title: Theme: Emerald
items.description: The Corsair theme on a zinc base with an emerald primary. Installs the theme first, then sets its colours and radius; every text pair meets WCAG AA.

items.name: theme-amber
items.title: Theme: Amber
items.description: The Corsair theme on a stone base with an amber primary and square corners. Installs the theme first, then sets its colours and radius; every text pair meets WCAG AA.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn() helper: merges class names and resolves conflicting Tailwind utilities.

items.name: spotify-track
items.title: getSpotifyTrack
items.description: Title, artist, cover and preview clip for a Spotify link, read on the server from the public embed page.

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery
items.description: Subscribes to a CSS media query. SSR-safe: renders a fallback on the server and hydrates without a mismatch.

items.name: use-in-view
items.title: useInView
items.description: Whether an element is in the viewport, from IntersectionObserver, with once, margin and amount options.

items.name: use-entrance
items.title: useEntrance
items.description: When a one-shot entrance runs: on first paint, or once in view, without hiding server-rendered content that is already on screen.

items.name: use-scroll-spy
items.title: useScrollSpy
items.description: The id of the section on screen, for a table of contents, from one IntersectionObserver. SSR-safe, keeps the last section between two.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action. Variants default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and link; sizes sm, default, lg and three square icon sizes. Supports asChild and a loading state.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Animated status indicator for work in progress, announced as Loading.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Short status or metadata label. Solid, secondary and outline styles, plus success, warning and destructive statuses shown as a coloured dot.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible name for a form control.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text control. Its error state comes from aria-invalid, so any form library can drive it.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text control with the same states as Input.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input with icons, text or buttons attached on either side.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Layout for a control with its label, description and error, plus fieldset and group helpers. Independent of any form library.

items.name: form
items.title: Form Field (react-hook-form)
items.description: FormField: a react-hook-form Controller laid out with Field, with the id, label and ARIA wiring done for you.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with checked, unchecked and indeterminate states.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of options where exactly one can be selected.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off control for settings that apply immediately.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one option from a list, with groups, labels and separators.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical divider.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Container with header, title, description, action, content and footer parts.

items.name: flip-card
items.title: Flip Card
items.description: A card with two faces that turns over in 3D on hover, from a trigger, or from a prop.

items.name: stamp
items.title: Stamp
items.description: A rubber stamp that slams onto the page: it starts large and transparent and lands rotated with a small overshoot.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Callout for important messages on a neutral surface; default, success, warning and destructive tones colour the icon.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder shape shown while content loads.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger, with header, title and description parts.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Searchable list navigated with the arrow keys; the base for comboboxes and command menus.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid for picking a date, several dates or a range, with dropdown captions and week numbers. Built on DayPicker.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: DatePicker and DateRangePicker: a calendar in a popover behind a button that shows the chosen date or range.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A select with a search box, for long lists of options.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time code input drawn as separate slots, with paste and autofill support.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a number or a range by dragging or with the arrow keys, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed, in default and outline variants and three sizes.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of toggles with single or multiple selection, joined or spaced apart.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A switch between two or more options with one thumb that slides to the active one, in three sizes. Never empty.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Number field with decrement and increment buttons, min, max and step, following the spinbutton keyboard pattern.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Password field with a button that shows what was typed.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label shown on hover and keyboard focus.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Fades and moves content into place when it scrolls into view, alone or staggered in a group. Visible without JavaScript.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: Reveals text word by word, when it comes into view or tied to the scroll position.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Pulls its content toward the mouse while hovered and springs it back on leave.

items.name: parallax
items.title: Parallax
items.description: Drifts content at a different speed from the page as it scrolls past, with CSS scroll-driven animations and no JavaScript.

items.name: tilt-scroll
items.title: Tilt Scroll
items.description: Content that starts tilted back in perspective and straightens as you scroll, with CSS scroll-driven animations and no JavaScript.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight
items.description: A soft light that follows the pointer across a surface and along its edge.

items.name: animated-border
items.title: Animated Border
items.description: A border with a light travelling around it, paused off screen.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Slow, soft light drifting behind its content, from three radial gradients.

items.name: signature
items.title: Signature
items.description: Draws SVG strokes as if by hand, with optional ink filling in behind the pen, on view or with the scroll.

items.name: path-beam
items.title: Path Beam
items.description: A beam of light travelling along the paths of a flow diagram, one after another, on view, with the scroll or from your own progress.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: An icon button that copies a value and swaps to a check mark, announcing it to screen readers.

items.name: dash-button
items.title: Dash Button
items.description: A pill button whose fill gives way to a dashed outline that marches on hover.

items.name: color-swatches
items.title: Color Swatches
items.description: Pick one colour from a row of swatches: a radio group with arrow keys and form support.

items.name: bars-spinner
items.title: Bars Spinner
items.description: Twelve bars around a hub fading in turn, announced as Loading. No JavaScript.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer Text
items.description: A band of light sweeping across text now and then, paused off screen.

items.name: blur-text
items.title: Blur Text
items.description: Text that comes into focus one character at a time, and can blur back out.

items.name: slide-text
items.title: Slide Text
items.description: Words, characters or lines rising into place from below their own baseline.

items.name: flip-text
items.title: Flip Text
items.description: Kinetic type in 3D: characters or words turning into place around their horizontal axis, one after another.

items.name: split-flap
items.title: Split Flap
items.description: A split-flap board: when the value changes, only the characters that changed flip, like a departure board.

items.name: dissolve-text
items.title: Dissolve Text
items.description: Words or characters surfacing at scattered moments, the same on server and client.

items.name: highlight-text
items.title: Highlight Text
items.description: A marker that slides in behind a phrase, or a hand-drawn line drawn under it.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Text that decodes itself: noise sweeps across, then each character locks in.

items.name: wave-text
items.title: Wave Text
items.description: Bands of colour washing through text like a swell, on one CSS animation.

items.name: text-signature
items.title: Text Signature
items.description: Writes any text in any font as a signature: outlines drawn by the pen, then inked.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Content scrolling in a seamless loop, pausing on focus and off screen, and draggable by the pointer.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: One series as a line, with a cursor that snaps to points; a slider for keyboards and screen readers.

items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR Code
items.description: A crisp SVG QR code in dots, rounded or square modules. Renders on the server, and can draw itself in.

items.name: tweet-card
items.title: Tweet Card
items.description: A post from X in your theme, with no embed script: a card, a server component that fetches by id, and a client one.

items.name: spotify-card
items.title: Spotify Card
items.description: A track card with cover art, a link to Spotify and a preview clip that spins a record while it plays.

items.name: light-rays
items.title: Light Rays
items.description: Soft beams of light falling from above, from a small WebGL2 shader.

items.name: warp-gradient
items.title: Warp Gradient
items.description: A liquid field of colour carried along by layered noise, from one WebGL2 shader.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal window centred over the page, with a focus trap, overlay, close button, header, footer, title and description parts.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Modal that asks the user to confirm or cancel before an action, with action and cancel buttons.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Dialog that slides in from any edge of the screen, for menus, filters and side panels.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Brief notifications shown with a toast() call and a Toaster mounted once, with variants, an optional action, swipe to dismiss and screen reader announcements.

items.name: nav-link
items.title: Nav Link
items.description: A navigation link that marks the current page with aria-current and data-active. Supports asChild for router links.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site Header
items.description: A sticky page header with brand, navigation, actions and a sheet menu for small screens, flagging data-scrolled once the page scrolls.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A floating bar of icon links pinned to the bottom or top of the viewport, with tooltips and an optional reveal after scrolling.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Sections of content shown one at a time, with a segmented or underlined tab list, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A round picture of a person with a fallback while it loads or when it fails, in three sizes, plus an overlapping group.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Stars for giving a score as a radio group, or for showing one read-only with fractional fills.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: Key figures as a description list: label, value and a caption with an optional trend arrow.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: A number that counts up to its value when it comes into view, formatted for the locale.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A block of code with an optional caption, a language label and a copy button.

items.name: corner-frame
items.title: Corner Frame
items.description: A box with bracket marks on its corners, in any size, thickness, colour and inset.

items.name: phone-frame
items.title: Phone Frame
items.description: A generic phone drawn in CSS around a screenshot or any content, with an island, a notch or no cut-out, that scales with its width.

items.name: browser-frame
items.title: Browser Frame
items.description: A browser window drawn in CSS around a page or a screenshot, with window dots, an address field and optional actions.

items.name: youtube-embed
items.title: YouTube Embed
items.description: A YouTube video that costs one poster image until it is played, with player controls through its ref.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides on a native scroll-snap track, with keyboard steps, previous and next buttons, dots and an optional coverflow look.

items.name: preloader
items.title: Preloader
items.description: A full-screen cover that counts to 100 on first load, waits for your content to be ready, then fades out.

items.name: custom-cursor
items.title: Custom Cursor
items.description: A dot and a trailing ring that follow a mouse pointer, growing over interactive elements and showing labels.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: A reading progress bar that fills as the page scrolls, with CSS scroll-driven animations and no JavaScript.

items.name: scroll-background
items.title: Scroll Background
items.description: A background that blends from one colour to the next as you scroll, with CSS scroll-driven animations and no JavaScript.

items.name: scroll-scene
items.title: Scroll Scene
items.description: A scrollytelling scene: a stage pinned beside steps, crossfading to the slide of the step on screen, with a 0 to 1 scroll progress variable for scrubbing.

items.name: wipe-transition
items.title: Wipe Transition
items.description: Switches content behind a band that sweeps across it, swapping while covered, with a crossfade for phones and reduced motion.

items.name: smooth-scroll
items.title: Smooth Scroll
items.description: Smooth wheel and trackpad scrolling for the page, off with reduced motion, with a scrollTo hook that works either way.

items.name: grain
items.title: Grain
items.description: Film grain over a surface, from a tile of SVG noise, with an optional stepped jitter.

items.name: hover-reveal
items.title: Hover Reveal
items.description: A second layer seen through a soft circle that follows the pointer.

items.name: particles
items.title: Particles
items.description: Dots drifting slowly across a surface, laid out from a seed and moved with CSS alone.

items.name: topography
items.title: Topography
items.description: Contour lines like a topographic map over slowly shifting terrain, from one WebGL2 shader.

items.name: roll-text
items.title: Roll Text
items.description: Characters that roll up to a copy of themselves on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions and options that opens from a button, with checkbox and radio items, labels, shortcuts and submenus.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu of actions for an area of the page that opens on right click or long press, with checkbox and radio items, labels, shortcuts and submenus.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation with links and triggers that open panels of links in a shared, animated viewport.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview card that appears while a link is hovered or focused, for supplementary content.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked sections that open and close under their headings, one or several at a time, with a height animation.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A region that a trigger button shows and hides, with a height animation.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A progress bar for tasks with a known amount, or an indeterminate one when the amount is unknown.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrolling box with thin themed scrollbars that keeps native scrolling.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The trail of links from the top of a site to the current page, with separators and an ellipsis.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links with previous and next, an ellipsis, and a helper that works out which page numbers to show.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A data table on native table elements, with a scroll container, selected rows and sortable column headers.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An application sidebar that collapses to icons or off canvas on desktop and opens as a sheet on mobile, with a keyboard shortcut.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom sheet dialog for phones that can also be dragged down to close.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A table with sortable headers, a text filter, pagination and row selection, built on TanStack Table v9.

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: A file drop area on a native file input that checks type, size and count, and lists the chosen files.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key or key combination shown as a small keycap, alone or in a group.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: What a list, table or page shows when it has nothing in it yet, with an icon, title, description and actions.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: The steps of a multi-step flow with complete, current and upcoming states, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A vertical list of events with a coloured dot for each status and a line joining them.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels resized by dragging or with the keyboard, side by side or stacked.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: One series as vertical or horizontal bars that grow in on first view, with a keyboard slider over the bars.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: One or more series as gradient-filled areas, stacked or overlapping, with a legend and a keyboard slider over the points.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: Parts of a whole as a ring with the total in the middle and a keyboard-navigable legend of values and shares.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: The opening section of a landing page with an eyebrow, a title, a description, actions and an optional media slot.

items.name: feature-grid
items.title: Feature Grid
items.description: A grid of features with an icon, a title and a description under a centred section header.

items.name: stats
items.title: Stats
items.description: A row of key figures that count up when they scroll into view, under a centred section header.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo Cloud
items.description: Customer or partner logos in a grid or a scrolling marquee under a small title.

items.name: cta
items.title: Call to Action
items.description: A closing band with a title, a description and one or two actions.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: A pricing section with plan cards, a featured plan and an optional monthly or yearly billing switch.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: A frequently asked questions section with a header and the answers in an accordion, split or stacked.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: A section of customer quotes with names, roles and avatars, in a masonry or grid layout.

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact Form
items.description: A contact section with a header, contact details and a validated message form that reports pending, success and error states.

items.name: newsletter
items.title: Newsletter
items.description: A compact sign-up band with an inline email form that reports pending, success and error states.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site Footer
items.description: A page footer with a brand, link columns in a navigation landmark, a copyright line and optional social icon links.

items.name: login-form
items.title: Login Form
items.description: A centred sign-in card with email and password fields, a remember-me checkbox, optional sign-in providers and pending, success and error states.

items.name: signup-form
items.title: Signup Form
items.description: A centred sign-up card with name, email and password fields, a required terms checkbox, optional sign-up providers and pending, success and error states.

items.name: not-found
items.title: Not Found
items.description: A 404 page section with a large decorative error code, a page heading, a description, an optional search slot and actions.

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: An application page with a collapsible sidebar, a header, stat cards, a line chart and a recent-activity table.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: An account settings page with tabs for a profile form, a password change and delete-account dialog, and notification switches.
